physicalNotes: Radius 0.843 +/- 0.031 solar radii from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-50 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract): 586,475 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 5400 +/- 100 K from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-50 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
